findings.message: The specification Sources section acknowledges that no supporting documents or attached reference images were copied, but it does not resolve or mark the missing material as a clarification. The description references an attached plotter; an implementation can satisfy the general polished, Desmos-inspired REQ-002/AC-002 while missing attachment-specific requirements. The pinned clarification:current-phase, specification generation 2 (Q-001, Q-002, Q-003) resolves equation coverage and form only, not the missing visual reference. Provide the needed materials or confirm that no additional attachment-specific constraints are intended before treating this visual scope as complete.

findings.quote: take any equation and plot the graph
findings.message: The specification imposes a one-equation-per-graph limit and explicitly forbids overlaying a second equation (REQ-001/AC-001), but the pinned Story does not state that exclusion. The specification-generation-2 clarification record (clarification:current-phase, Q-001 through Q-003) narrows equation form and implicit-versus-explicit scope, not the number of equations per graph. An implementation that plots the requested implicit quadratic and also supports another equation could satisfy the source request yet violate this new restriction. Confirm whether multi-equation graphs are intentionally out of scope, or remove the unsupported restriction.
